$description: Semantic tokens for the Lira for Professionals MARKETING PAGE (/lira-for-professionals, in lira-website). Reduced to what the page uses on 2026-10-15, when it moved to direction B: a white page, the logo's dark green as the hero field and as the action on light, mint as the action on the green field, sage only for small labels, Geist and Geist Mono for type, no serif. Everything not listed here is a primitive the page uses directly (neutrals, feedback colours) or does not use at all.
$note: Not the clinical app. That is pro-app.json. The website does not import this file: src/app/globals.css mirrors it by hand under [data-surface="pro"], and the page itself is Tailwind classes on lira-brand-*, lira-cool-* and lira-sage-*. If a value changes here, change it there in the same commit, and the other way round.

app.$description: White. The green field carries the contrast

subtle.$description: Alternating sections (how it works, team, FAQ)

field.$description: Hero, claim band, CTA: the field of the logo. The footer is one step darker, #163026, written by hand

secondary.$description: 4.6:1 on background.subtle; there is no third level

onField.$description: On the green field. Body copy there is white at 75% opacity

eyebrow.$description: Small uppercase labels only. Sage has no other job on this surface since October 2026

onLight.$description: Solid button on white or cool.50, white text

onField.$description: Solid button on the green field, cool.900 text (11:1). Mint is never a button on a light background

link.$description: Text links, with the arrow; hover goes to sage.500

button.$description: 8 to 10px. The pill went with the mint-on-light button

frame.$description: The product window. 16px, with a 1px light outline over the field

sans.$description: Display and body. The family the clinical app uses, so site and product read as one thing
